cohort: The study included 6574 women who gave birth to live fetuses weighing a minimum of 500 g and with a gestational age of at least 22 weeks.
finding: The overall CS rate was 30.5%, with Robson group 5 having the highest individual CS rate (30.3%) and being the largest contributor to the absolute CS rate.
mod_finding: Robson group 5 demonstrated the highest individual CS rate (30.3%) and was identified as the largest contributor to the overall absolute CS rate.
